page.layout: One block of running text in a single column, set large; a printed page-mark ornament at the head; a catchword "IN-" at the lower right. No margin notes.

main_text.p: braeum cum verfione quandoque correctiori, & augmentis quibusdam apponeremus. Vale interim, conatibus fave noftris, & mox Obfervationes facras in HymnosDavidis, cum Epiftolis MSS. Andreae Masii, Viri maximi, exspecta. Herbornae Nasloviorum, a.d. viii. Februarii, Anni cIↄ. Iↄc. XCIV.

page.notes: The ornament at the head is a printer's device, not text. Catchword "IN-" is at the lower right. The first word "braeum" is probably "Graecum" with the initial cut off in the scan; the visible text begins "braeum", so it is copied as seen. Roman numerals with reversed C are given as printed (cIↄ, Iↄc). The Roman numeral "XCIV" appears on a separate line in the scan and is kept as printed.
